items.title: Harrison Barnes Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: And my brothers say, think we can play a little bit? ... And now the fella, he's a kind of professor in there. And they got there and he explained to them... And I had the trumpet, you know, and I was playing the trumpet, so.

ctx.x: Were they still living? Any of your brothers living?
No, they're all down. Thomas Bonds was the oldest. Freddie Bonds.
How much older was the oldest brother than you?
